_comment: RECORDED RESULTS FOR THE NAMED MANUAL CHECKS in scripts/checks/dfu-done.ps1.
A clause that cannot be machine-evaluated is printed by that script as a NAMED manual
check and lands in the refusing bucket 'manual_pending' until a result appears HERE
under that exact name. There is no path from 'unrecorded' to 'fine'.
A record is only a result when it carries ALL FOUR fields. A record missing any of
them is a note somebody left, not a check somebody ran, and dfu-done.ps1 ignores it:
verdict   'pass' or 'fail' - what the check actually returned. A recorded 'fail' is
a DEFINITE failure and makes the clause unmet, not pending.
by        WHO ran it. Per the merge protocol this must not be the person who built
the thing being checked.
date      when, ISO 8601
evidence  what they saw - a command and its output, a file:line, a permalink.
'looked fine' is not evidence.
THE CHECKS THIS RUN ASKS FOR (names are emitted by the script; these are the ones the
live plan currently produces):
wiki-compiler-personal-exclusion
Drive the wiki compiler over a corpus containing a personal-labelled thought and
confirm no published wiki_pages row carries its content. The script cannot do it:
the compiler runs on its own schedule, so a query for a seconds-old fixture
returns nothing whatever the boundary does. That probe was REMOVED rather than
kept, because a probe that cannot fail is worse than no probe.
section-2-column-mapping-<PHASE>
Section 2's column for that phase names no runnable artifact, so no machine can
confirm the walkthrough command re-runs THAT column. Confirm by hand which command
satisfies it - or better, make the column name its check and this entry disappears.
u7-cycle-judged-against-pinned-anchor
Confirm the recorded U7 cycle was judged against a PINNED section 0/B research
anchor and carries the anchor citation or the ledger amendment.
THIS FILE IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY OF RESULTS. Adding an entry here that nobody ran is
the same defect as amending a plan column to get a green, one file over.
Shape:
"u7-cycle-judged-against-pinned-anchor": {
"verdict": "pass", "by": "<who>", "date": "2026-09-01",
"evidence": "<what they saw>"
